text: ふんか　かつどうを　しているか　ふんかしそうな　かざんを　かっかざんと　いうぞ！

structure.jp: ふんか　かつどうを　しているか
ふんかしそうな　かざんを
structure.en: a volcano that looks likely to erupt

structure.jp: かっかざんと　いうぞ！

patterns.name: 〜という (naming)
patterns.span: かっかざんと　いう
patterns.explanation: A を B と いう means 'A is called B'. かざんを　かっかざんと　いう = 'such a volcano is called an active volcano'.

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (looks like)
patterns.explanation: そう on a cut-down verb means 'looks like it is about to' do it. な lets it describe the thing after it. ふんかしそうな　かざん = 'a volcano that looks about to erupt'.

patterns.name: 〜か (or)
patterns.explanation: か between two choices means 'or'. ふんか　かつどうを　しているか　ふんかしそうな = 'is erupting, or looks likely to erupt'.
